description: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of categories within a dataset of 1.4 million open-source distilled reasoning examples, designed to support large language model training. It is divided into seven distinct segments, each representing a different task category with its corresponding count and percentage of the total. The largest segment is “Math,” shown in light red, accounting for 29.3% (410,756 instances). The second largest is “Coding,” in blue, at 24.3% (339,907). “Information Seeking,” in bright green, follows with 22.2% (311,427). “Reasoning,” in light orange, comprises 10.4% (145,329). A combined “Others” category, in light green, makes up 9.3% (130,671). Smaller segments include “Planning” in lavender (2.3%, 31,757) and “Creative Writing” in pink (2.2%, 30,144). A legend in the upper left confirms the color coding and raw counts for each category. The chart visually emphasizes the dominance of Math, Coding, and Information Seeking, while the smaller categories are proportionally represented with minimal visual weight.
